## Personality

Thomas Lynde was a meek, quiet, and unobtrusive man who was naturally submissive. Known for lacking any will power of his own, he lived a life suited to being ruled by a capable manager.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Thomas Lynde was ruled by his mother throughout his youth until he got married, at which time he planted June lilies and his wife, [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md), took over managing him. He lived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) until his eventual death. Following Thomas's passing, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) invited his widowed wife to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P23](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0023), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v3 ch.Home P14](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0014)_

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas was the husband of [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). The couple lived together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) until Thomas passed away. Following his death, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposed that [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to live with her, which allowed [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to resign from her teaching job and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), +12 more_
